am.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite in one call: the bulk form of the
single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files without a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `ti
tle` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported individually: a `failed`…\n- [Generate eval cases fr
om the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the
suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and persists them: the only edit route that connec
ts to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.\n- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents case
s from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JS
ON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…\n- [Read an ev
al authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job st
arted by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Wr
ite a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jo
bs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed addit
ions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get on
e eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project.
A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-e
val-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it are not affected.\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps`
REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level ove
rride and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifa
ct.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storag
eId` the run's results then reference. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n- [Get an uplo
ad URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Ever
y request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.
17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the
`storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval
-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK rep
orting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist
advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist
advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsup
ported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/in
gest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. Th
is is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) us
es MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` r
oute (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md):
Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed
from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather th
an something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-inge
stion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Appe
nd iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one ba
tch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an e
val. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no
debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Open a run for increme
ntal ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterati
ons are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n- [Get a run's g
ate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `nul
l`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who can grant one: a waiver its readers cannot see is not a visibl
e waiver.\n- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's rel
ease gate until an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited
record, and every surface that honors it, such as the CLI's `eval gate`, reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and until when.
\n- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting t
he gate back. Requires the manage tier.\n- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-deterministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permiss
ion and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned co
ntinuation object with the unchanged draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second op
erat…\n- [Get the host-compat catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-host-compat-catalog.md): The versione
d host-compatibility catalog backing `mcpjam compat` verdicts. Public and unauthenticated: static host facts and creation config w
ith no project or user scope. Always returns a catalog: `source` is `live` when the published catalog was reachable and `bundled`
when serving the SDK's built…\n- [Get the authenticated account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticat
ed-account.md): The user behind the API key (keys act as their creator, scoped to one organization).\n- [Read the organization's s
pend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organ
ization may spend on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and computer time) in the current billing window, and how much of it
